meta.name: Campus Beats
meta.description:
What starts as an agenda to get closure for her past , a GenZ girl uncovers her hidden dancing talent and in the process experiences the real meaning of friendship, love, freedom and justice in a modern dance academy divided sharply across socio-economic class.

Rated U/A 16+ · Returning Series · First aired 21 Sept 2023 · India · Language: Hindi
Studio: Banijay Asia · Network: Amazon miniTV, Amazon MX Player

videos.title: Team M.A.D
videos.overview: A struggle for power happens between Netra and Rihanna, who both want to be the leader of the newly formed ‘MAD’ crew. It is only a crew on paper, the OGs and BGs can’t put their differences aside. Netra has a bigger crisis to worry about as someone closes in on her true identity.

videos.title: Meet & Greet
videos.overview: A meet and greet with MAD’s rivals at Club Raven turns into a street dance challenge. Netra, who uses the venue for her investigation, must decide between learning more about Club Raven’s involvement in her father’s death or help her crew.

videos.title: Pyaar Wala Love
videos.overview: Netra and Ishaan’s chemistry shines against the Superiors. Ri realizes that Netra can ensure MAD’s success and willingly gives up her leadership. Netra’s investigation takes a meaningful turn as an insider at Club Raven agrees to meet her. Everything seems to be going perfectly, but can Netra handle the challenges of being a leader and an investigator?

videos.title: The Situation-ship
videos.overview: Shekhawat questions the results of Netra’s meeting with Shammi dada. Elsewhere, Ri and Malang develop a friendship that doesn’t sit well with one OG crew member. Netra and Ishaan have their ‘private lessons’ deepens their connection – but can Netra deal with the jealousy she faces from the women around Ishaan?

videos.title: Competition vs Information
videos.overview: Netra must balance being a leader and investigating her father’s death as the street competition looms. There is chaos and drama everywhere and the pressure piles on Netra from all directions. Netra meets a new source in Club Raven but soon realizes that she is facing a powerful enemy.

videos.title: Divided We Fall
videos.overview: Netra is harrowed by her embarrassing fall from grace in the street competition. Rihanna can’t handle the failure and goes back to her old ways. It seems like everything has gone back to square one… even zero, so Netra decides to take matters into her own hands for better or for worse. Ishaan comes to Netra’s rescue as she is cornered by Ravjeet. But the mental pressure of her failures builds up.

videos.title: Heartache
videos.overview: Neel faces a fight within himself about his identity. When everything seems bleak for Netra, a glimmer of hope appears, giving her the chance to redeem herself. Shekhawat gives a morale boost to Netra. Netra decides to walks on the path of her new mission " Mission Dance".

videos.title: Emotional Damage
videos.overview: Netra tries to make things right with those around her, and takes on Rihanna in a verbal fight, which becomes the talk of the town at MAD. Ishaan, Netra, Malang and Rihanna bear the brunt of MAD’s digital gossip, which seems to be getting worse and worse with every message, reaction, emoji, and meme!

videos.title: Undo Secrets
videos.overview: Netra learns a secret about a Ruthless member that can help with her investigation. Amit tries to plant seeds of doubt between Netra and Ishaan. Neel, impacted by Taha’s routine fights between accepting himself and living up to his mother’s expectations.

videos.title: Choose Love
videos.overview: Netra is haunted by Club Raven’s cryptic parties, but tries to distract herself by preparing for Dance Camp. Shekhawat uses Netra’s information to move the investigation forward. Ishaan, confused by Netra’s feelings towards him, decides to make his feelings clear – but is that the best approach?

videos.title: Dance Camp Day 1
videos.overview: Dance Camp starts with a bang. Netra is still troubled by Ishaan's behavior and avoids him. Su and the BGs compete with the OGs to prove a point. Netra is paid a surprise visit by someone important - which adds more chaos to her life

videos.title: Dance Camp Day 2
videos.overview: Ishaan and Netra sort their differences out. Ri is troubled by her deteriorating relationship with Ishaan. The second dance of Dance Camp promises more excitement, action, and competition between the BGs and the OGs

videos.title: Loosing is Not Failing
videos.overview: Ri's attempt at breaking Netra's focus fails, and the tables turn when her mother visits Dance Camp. Neel consoles Malang about his loss. Netra is shown appreciation her newfound fans but her happiness doesn't last for long.

videos.title: Dance Camp Day 3
videos.overview: Netra is taken aback by Jiggy's slap but plays it cool to avoid drawing attention to the investigation. Malang helps Neel when he is cornered by Troy. Ishaan shows his romantic side to Netra that takes their relationship to the next level.

videos.title: The Beginning Of The End
videos.overview: Netra gets new information about Club Raven's party. Shekhawat and his team get ready to expose Ravjeet and his associates. Netra decides to rescue Kiran from a catastrophic situation.

videos.title: The Countdown Begins
videos.overview: Shekhawat's raid is foiled. Netra tries to come to terms with Ishaan and Ruthless's involvement with her father's death. Malang is confused and unsure by Neel's feelings towards him. Netra discovers something shocking about Ishaan

videos.title: The Dilemma
videos.overview: Rihanna and Ishaan recall the night of Lokhande's death. Netra loses her trust Ishaan, but fakes her nonchalance to learn about who killed her father. At a party, a drunk Ri reveals a dark secret to Netra.

videos.title: The Cat Is Out The Bag
videos.overview: Netra doubles down on her investigation of Ruthless. Kiran reveals Peeyali's involvement as a supplier to Club Raven. Ravjeet and his gang decide to break Netra by pitting Ishaan against her - but will it work?

videos.title: The Secret
videos.overview: Ishaan begins to doubt whether Netra ever felt something towards him. Ri is haunted by the night of Lokhande's death. Netra's investigation comes to a conclusion as she learns who killed her father.

videos.title: The Truth
videos.overview: Ri's arrest creates a divide between Netra and Ishaan. Ties are broken and a challenge is drawn. All is not as it seems and we realize that. Lokahnde's death is part of a bigger game plan, but who is pulling the strings?

videos.title: The Change
videos.overview: Two years after its golden era, MAD Academy's reputation has dimmed, leaving dance school struggling. Ishaan stages a surprise performance at the World Dance Awards with underprivileged teens, highlighting talent beyond MAD's walls. MAD's leaders consider reuniting the original Ruthless team. We uncover Ishaan's complex family dynamics and a surprise awaits him at his sister's sangeet celebration.

videos.title: Lost Love.. Found
videos.overview: Ishaan and Netra unexpectedly cross paths at a wedding, where old wounds and unresolved emotions resurface. Seeing Netra’s new reality as a wedding dancer, Ishaan is filled with guilt and regret, leading to a tense reunion. When Neel and Figo try persuading Ishaan to rejoin M.A.D, he learns that a former member has already rejoined the academy.

videos.title: Welcome To M.A.D.
videos.overview: Ishaan and Netra engage in a powerful dance showdown, exposing their chemistry and shared past. After two years, the Ruthless team returns to M.A.D as Vishal announces auditions for new members who will participate in the World Dance championship. Tensions rise with Ahaan, who leads a rebellion among students, challenging Ruthless.

videos.title: Audition Party
videos.overview: Tensions peak as Ishaan and Ahaan clash in a high-stakes dance showdown, only for Netra to step in, worried about Ishaan's injury. At M.A.D's audition party, students unite, sparking old and new rivalries and unearthing unresolved romantic tensions. Ishaan's frustration grows as Ahaan tries to charm Netra.

videos.title: Love And Other Monsters
videos.overview: Tensions mount as Ishaan struggles with his feelings for Netra, watching her grow closer to Ahaan. Within the dance crew, friendships, rivalries, and surprising bonds emerge as ambitions collide, leaving Netra caught between loyalty and leadership.

videos.title: The Tough Choice
videos.overview: As tensions between Ishaan and Ahaan rise, Netra faces a tough choice and steps down as captain to maintain peace. A fight at a dhaba unexpectedly unites the team, while Ishaan and Netra share a charged, emotional dance that reveals their unspoken feelings.

videos.title: No Pain No Gain
videos.overview: Ishaan and Netra's unresolved tension peaks, as he distances himself to cope through underground battles. Meanwhile, Netra's attempt at creating social media content with Ahaan sparks jealousy in Ishaan.

videos.title: Traas, Takleef & Torture
videos.overview: Netra discovers that Amit has deceived her and Moksh, leading them into unsavory gigs. While Moksh finds unexpected support from Neel, Netra confronts Ishaan, who struggles with his emotions through self-destructive underground battles. As tensions escalate, Netra stumbles upon Ishaan in a dangerous face-off, each facing the cost of their unresolved turmoil.

videos.title: Dating App
videos.overview: Ishaan is devastated when he discovers that Netra has moved on, while Netra grapples with complex emotions, torn between loyalty and letting go. Taha visits the vibrant dance fest. The crew tries to lighten the mood, pushing Ishaan and Netra to explore new relationships via a dating app.

videos.title: Moving On
videos.overview: Ishaan’s world is shaken when he sees Netra on a dating app, pushing him into a night of reckless decisions with friends. As Netra tries to distance herself from him by focusing on World Dance championship, their once effortless connection falters painfully during a rehearsal. Meanwhile, Ahaan, determined to impress Netra, agrees to train with Ishaan, setting up an emotional confrontation.

videos.title: The Calm Before The Storm
videos.overview: Ishaan agrees to secretly train Ahaan, hiding their partnership. Meanwhile, Netra grapples with her complicated feelings for Ishaan, feeling his absence in the rehearsal hall and struggling to focus on the upcoming WDC performance. Ahaan, embarrassed by a prank and uncomfortable with his performance, clashes with Ishaan, ultimately revealing that he's trying to impress Netra.

videos.title: Fight For Your Love
videos.overview: Ishaan wrestles with his feelings as Ahaan's confession about liking Netra. Neel and Figo rally around Ishaan, encouraging him to confront his emotions and find clarity in his complicated relationship with Netra. Meanwhile, Netra discovers Ishaan's secret training sessions with Ahaan.

videos.title: Rose Day
videos.overview: Rose Day stirs up romantic entanglements and misunderstandings. Netra, hoping to make amends with Ishaan, leaves him a rose and note, which he doesn't find, sparking jealousy when he sees her with Ahaan. Meanwhile, Neel and Moksh grow closer, while Tia disrupts the dynamic by openly pursuing Ishaan.

videos.title: Truth Bombs
videos.overview: Ahaan confronts Ishaan after discovering his connection with Netra, feeling manipulated and betrayed. Ishaan tries to explain, but misunderstandings deepen, affecting the crew's unity and preparations for WDC video entry.

videos.title: The Proposal
videos.overview: Tensions peak as Netra, Ishaan, and Ahaan grapple with their emotions before the World Dance Championship video entry. Ishaan plans to propose to Netra, but a twist in the performance leads to an unintentional confession to Ahaan, leaving Ishaan heartbroken. The episode ends with a shocking revelation as Rihanna returns as the captain of a rival team, setting the stage for intense competition.

videos.title: Pyaar And Waar
videos.overview: Ri and Malang's grand entry shakes Ruthless as Beat Breakers' performance includes chunks of their choreography. Netra is furious, but Ishaan stops her from causing a scene. Meanwhile, Neel is devastated by Malang's betrayal. Ri taunts Netra's leadership, promising to never let her win. Meanwhile, Ishaan is deeply affected by Netra mistakenly confessing her love to Ahaan.

videos.title: Let The Games Begin
videos.overview: Ishaan and Netra finally confess their love, cementing their relationship. Meanwhile, Ruthless prepares for WDC eliminations, where every move counts. As the team reaches the venue, tensions rise between Neel and Moksh, while Ahaan, dealing with his own demons, finally joins. However, Ri's presence looms large, setting the stage for a high-stakes competition filled with rivalries and mind games.

videos.title: All Is Fair In Love And Dance
videos.overview: Ahaan's emotional outburst causes chaos as a leaked video threatens Ruthless' standing at WDC. As the team scrambles to contain the damage, Malang confronts Neel, cruelly telling him that their past was a mistake. Ri, meanwhile, plays mind games with Ishaan, reigniting old wounds. When the real culprit behind the video is revealed, Ishaan is forced to apologize to Ri giving her the upper hand.

videos.title: WDC Round 01- Solos
videos.overview: WDC's first solo round sparks drama and betrayal as Ruthless and Beat Breakers clash in an intense battle for victory.

videos.title: Tit For Tat
videos.overview: After Ruthless' first loss, Ri taunts Netra, claiming Ishaan will lose interest in her, causing Netra to worry. Meanwhile, Beat Breakers secretly recruit two new members, shocking Ruthless. Neel struggles with his emotions, pushing Moksh away. As duet rounds approach, tensions soar, and both teams gear up for battle. The stage is set for an intense showdown as Netra and Ri face off once more.

videos.title: Do The Duet
videos.overview: As Ruthless dominates the duet round, Ri intensifies her mind games, manipulating WDC officials against Netra. Meanwhile, Ishaan confronts Ri, only to be blindsided when she reveals a past kiss between them. Netra, arriving at the worst moment, sees photographic proof, leaving her shaken. While Ruthless celebrates victory, Ishaan finds himself caught in Ri's web, risking everything with Netra.

videos.title: The Misunderstanding
videos.overview: Netra struggles to trust Ishaan after Ri's revelation, leading to an emotional confrontation. Meanwhile, Neel warns Moksh about Ri's manipulation, and Malang wrestles with his feelings for Neel. Tensions rise as Neel and Malang nearly kiss, only for Malang's past trauma to push him away. Just as Netra and Ishaan start mending things, WDC officials drop a bombshell.

videos.title: The Complaint
videos.overview: With Neel facing expulsion over bullying accusations, Netra fights for his innocence while Ri stands by Malang. As WDC investigates, CCTV footage reveals a private moment between Neel and Malang, hinting at a deeper history. Ri eventually helps uncover the real culprit—Amit. With Malang's hidden trauma coming to light, Neel is cleared.

videos.title: Lovers Tiff
videos.overview: Ishaan and Netra's intense performance wins over the judges, propelling Ruthless to the top. With only four teams left, rivals reconcile, but Ri secretly spikes drinks at an OG party, leading to chaos. A drugged Ishaan mistakes Ri for Netra during a sensual dance, almost giving in until he realizes the truth. When Ri crosses the line, Netra arrives in time.

videos.title: The Reunioun
videos.overview: Ishaan and Netra's intense performance wins over the judges, propelling Ruthless to the top. With only four teams left, rivals reconcile, but Ri secretly spikes drinks at an OG party, leading to chaos. A drugged Ishaan mistakes Ri for Netra during a sensual dance, almost giving in until he realizes the truth. When Ri crosses the line, Netra arrives in time.

videos.title: Ishaan VS Rihanna
videos.overview: Ishaan and Netra's intense performance wins over the judges, propelling Ruthless to the top. With only four teams left, rivals reconcile, but Ri secretly spikes drinks at an OG party, leading to chaos. A drugged Ishaan mistakes Ri for Netra during a sensual dance, almost giving in until he realizes the truth. When Ri crosses the line, Netra arrives in time.

videos.title: The Loss At WD
videos.overview: As Ruthless is disqualified, Moksh is blamed, causing team tension. Ishaan fights for justice, but WDC refuses to reconsider. Ri's manipulation is exposed, causing a rift within Beat Breakers. Meanwhile, Netra receives a devastating blow MAD has terminated her, backing Ri instead. As Ishaan comforts a broken Netra, Ri revels in her victory, declaring she will take everything from Netra.

videos.title: The Fairwell
videos.overview: As Ruthless faces its farewell, Malang quits Beat Breakers, choosing integrity over victory. Ishaan reassures Netra they will rebuild without MAD or WDC. Meanwhile, Ri plots to reclaim Ishaan but faces betrayal within her team. A confrontation between Netra and Ri turns intense, but as the argument peaks, Ri experiences sudden hearing loss, collapses, and Netra is the only one there to catch her.

videos.title: The Twist
videos.overview: Ri is devastated after being diagnosed with permanent hearing loss, and Mehrotra forces her to resign from Beat Breakers. Meanwhile, Netra discovers a WDC scholarship but ultimately chooses to stay with Ruthless. As tensions explode at Mehrotra's party, Ishaan and Netra expose his cruelty. In a shocking twist, Beat Breakers resigns, making Ruthless the new finalist.

videos.title: Love VS Honor
videos.overview: Ruthless wins WDC India, with Ri as manager and Moksh returning for Neel. Meanwhile, Mehrotra threatens Netra, forcing her to choose between Ishaan's future and her own dreams. She pretends to leave for London, shattering Ishaan. As he begs her to stay, she runs into the street only to be hit by a car. Ishaan screams in horror as the season ends with Netra's fate hanging in the balance.
